## What you should be able to do tonight

- Produce a document that states the selection procedure before the results and the screen count on the first page.
- State what would have made you abandon the strategy and whether it happened.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, fourteenth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and 15 percent of 84 and 84 divided by 7 in your head.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Random walks start here, and they run for the next thirteen weeks. Gambler's ruin: you start with 10 units, bet one unit per fair coin flip, and stop at 0 or 20. Probability you reach 20? Now do it when the coin pays out with probability 0.49 and say how much the answer moves.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Expected duration of the same game, which is the part people forget: how many flips on average before the fair version ends? Derive it from the difference equation rather than quoting the product.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 3 closes phase 3 with a complete strategy: selection rule, derived thresholds, dynamic hedging, one out-of-sample run, and a false positive rate measured on synthetic data. Whatever its Sharpe, the pipeline it exercised is the one phase 5 rebuilds properly.
:::
